changelog:
Initial release of sardis-balance: read-only wallet analytics and monitoring.

- Check real-time wallet balances across multiple agent wallets
- Generate detailed spending summaries (daily, weekly, monthly, etc.)
- Review full transaction history with rich filtering options
- Track remaining budgets against daily/weekly/monthly limits
- All features are strictly read-only (no payment execution or wallet modification)
summary: Read-only balance checking and spending analytics for Sardis agent wallets
